name: Ryufin
description: Official hosted MCP server of Ryufin, free US stock research built from SEC EDGAR filings and end-of-day prices for 3,000+ US-listed companies. Six tools: search_stocks, get_stock_answers (five plain verdicts on the business, safety, price, growth and market, each with its evidence and filing date), get_stock_overview, get_financial_history (reported series from 10-K and 10-Q filings), get_company_news (8-K current reports linked to sec.gov) and get_answer_changes. No sign-up and no API key; 60 requests a minute per address.
author: Ryufin
